nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @hive-mind/cli package, describing 6 shell commands (recall-context, save-session, harvest-local, cognify, compile-wiki, maintenance) designed to drive hive-mind memory from SessionStart/Stop hooks and nightly cron jobs, with install instructions and usage examples.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-cli, declaring the hive-mind-cli binary entry point, ESM module type, dependencies on hive-mind-core/mcp-server/wiki-compiler siblings, and a postinstall.cjs hook that installs a Windows .cmd shim for Claude Code MCP integration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ESM module type with a CommonJS postinstall script (postinstall.cjs) to handle the Windows .cmd shim — a mixed-module pattern required by npm's lifecycle hook execution.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript composite project configuration for hive-mind-cli, extending the monorepo base config and declaring project references to hive-mind-core, hive-mind-mcp-server, and hive-mind-wiki-compiler to enable incremental builds.
